context: The agent wrote a getting started tutorial for the DataSync SDK targeting a global developer audience. The criteria evaluate whether the agent followed Google-style documentation conventions for dates, times, numbers, punctuation, placeholders, prose structure, and inclusive examples — without being told which specific rules to apply.

checklist.name: International date format
checklist.description: Any date appearing in the tutorial uses ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) or the 'DD Month YYYY' format (e.g., '17 June 2026'). No dates in MM/DD/YYYY or M/D/YYYY format.

checklist.name: Timezone specified
checklist.description: The maintenance window time (or any other specific time mentioned) includes an explicit timezone designation (e.g., UTC, JST, CET).

checklist.name: Serial comma in inline list
checklist.description: Any inline comma-separated list of three or more items uses a serial (Oxford) comma before the final 'and' or 'or' (e.g., 'JSON, XML, and YAML').

checklist.name: No trailing 'etc.'
checklist.description: No list or inline enumeration ends with 'etc.' or 'etc'.

checklist.name: En dash for version/number range
checklist.description: The version range (or any numeric range) uses an en dash (–) rather than a hyphen (-) between the numbers (e.g., '2.0–3.5' not '2.0-3.5').

checklist.name: Numbers zero–nine spelled out in prose
checklist.description: Single-digit numbers (zero through nine) that appear in non-technical prose are spelled out as words rather than numerals (e.g., 'five steps' not '5 steps' in a prose sentence).

checklist.name: ALL_CAPS descriptive placeholders
checklist.description: Placeholder values in the code block use descriptive ALL_CAPS names (e.g., YOUR_API_KEY, YOUR_PROJECT_ID) rather than lowercase or generic placeholders like 'key' or 'id'.

checklist.name: Numbered steps start with verb
checklist.description: Each step in the numbered installation/setup procedure begins with an imperative verb (e.g., 'Install', 'Configure', 'Run', 'Set').

checklist.name: Procedure introduced with sentence
checklist.description: The numbered installation/setup list is preceded by an introductory sentence (ending in a colon or period) that describes what the reader will accomplish.

checklist.name: Conditional step placed correctly
checklist.description: Any conditional step in the procedure puts the condition before the action (e.g., 'If you use a proxy, configure...' not 'Configure a proxy if you use one').

checklist.name: Diverse persona names
checklist.description: Any named example persona or user does NOT use exclusively Western/English names — at least one name from a non-Western cultural background appears (e.g., a Japanese, Indian, Brazilian, or African name).
